Voat is "open source" and available on Github.

Github is a site where people publish public/openSource code as well as private/internal projects. You can fork a project (make a copy of a project for yourself) and make changes to the project as if it was your own. If the original author likes the changes you made, then they can accept the request to make changes and make it a permanent part of their project.

Basically, I added a few lines of code in four specific files(out of hundreds), and if they want to accept dogecoin/litecoin, then they need to put their donation addresses in the place where I suggested a change in their code.
